links.outcome: Comprehension of key discharge information: AI accessibility-optimised letter vs conventional letter
links.effect: Comprehension scores were higher with the AI letter in Study 1 (median 4 vs 2) and Study 2 (median 4 vs 3), both P<0.001. All secondary outcomes also improved; no gain for follow-up date identification.
links.quote: Participants receiving the AI-generated discharge letter achieved significantly higher comprehension scores in both studies (Study 1: median 4 vs. 2; Study 2: median 4 vs. 3; both P < 0.001).

unlisted_practices: Prompting GPT-4 to generate accessibility-optimised, patient-friendly discharge letters to improve patient comprehension

screen.reason: Evaluates patient comprehension of a discharge letter generated by GPT-4 compared to a standard discharge letter in simulated reader studies.
